selectedRules.applicabilityReason: Track changed inputs and cached state provenance without treating warm state as cached output.
Preserve full workload, gate cost and quality outcomes under frozen sequential inputs.

facts.statement: native settle accepts initial state and resets history/stable counters. R26 preserves this controller.
Prior uniform initial-state and A→B carry experiments exist; R26 adds current-input rational contraction screening for sequential changed drives.
R25 exact tick shortcut preserved semantics but increased paired component time; gate and state storage costs must remain visible.

invariants.statement: Gate reads current program/config/drives and fixed norm weights only. Exact rational arithmetic computes the documented real-valued derivative upper bound. Prior state comes only from a past stable result of the same arm/stream/source binding.
invariants.scope: Four bounded authored streams, single worker; no cache across streams or arms

invariants.statement: Native recurrence/controller is unchanged; only initial state differs. All traces, readouts and Cost must replay from recorded inputs. Disagreement with reset is a research result, not an audit failure. Real-map contraction does not imply native bit equality or finite-stop answer equality.
invariants.scope: 72 native settles and saved scalar replay

invariants.statement: Record gate-inclusive CPU/wall, physical native costs, private-state storage and frozen cell order. No adaptive repeats, learning/measurement work or statistical speed claim.
invariants.scope: 4 streams x6 cells x3 arms; 600 seconds maximum

designChoices.statement: Reuse original native settle and a single prior state per stream/arm. Use Fraction with a fourth-order positive Taylor bound, avoiding transcendental floating certificate calculations.
designChoices.rationale: Small state space; preserve source and avoid a new cache framework.

verificationObligations.failureOracle: Rational gate mismatch, wrong source binding, future/cross-arm state or source-state mutation is accepted.
Native trace/scalar recurrence, initial provenance, logical Cost or declared matrix cannot be reconstructed; altered state/initial/readout accepted.
Workload/order/gate/total cost binding differs, invalid duration is accepted or quality disagreement is hidden. Negative efficiency is a valid outcome.
